verdict.rationale: Funnel analytics are a fair question for an identity-verification orchestration product, but the evidence never documents pass-rate, drop-off or completion-time reporting by country or document type. The Dashboard evidence covers only configuring which documents are accepted by country and type, which is an adjacent control. Workflow-status webhooks are a developer building block a user could build analytics on, not the analytics capability itself.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see verification funnel analytics — pass rates, drop-off points, completion time by country and document type — to know what verification is costing me in signups
